subject: Plastic Bag Ordinance Development
overview: The council moved to begin drafting a city ordinance to phase out plastic bags and authorized the administration to join a class-action lawsuit against pharmaceutical companies regarding the opioid epidemic. The body also approved a new police union contract and updated voting equipment for upcoming elections.

items.title: Police Department Budget Transfer
items.summary: Approved a $120,000 transfer from the police salary account to cover shortfalls in vehicle repairs and medical billing.

items.title: Police Patrolmen's Union Contract
items.summary: Approved the third reading of the Medford Police Patrolmen's Association contract.

items.title: Common Victualler License: 151 High St.
items.summary: Approved a license for G.N. Papa Corporation, doing business as Pizza and Roast Beef and Subs.

items.title: Plastic Bag Phase-Out Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution to phase out plastic bags to the City Solicitor for a draft ordinance, followed by a future meeting with the Committee of the Whole for public input.

items.title: Opioid Crisis Litigation
items.summary: Approved a resolution for the city to investigate joining a class-action lawsuit against pharmaceutical companies for damages related to the opioid epidemic.

items.title: Voting Machine Modernization
items.summary: Approved the replacement of AccuVote machines with ImageCast precinct tabulators for use starting in the September 2018 primary.

items.title: Public Access Television Oversight
items.summary: Heard a petition regarding restrictions and membership at the public access TV station; a motion to request a membership update from the station manager failed to find a second.

items.title: Circuit Road Streetlight Investigation
items.summary: Approved a request for the Superintendent of Lights and Lines to investigate a streetlight that remains on 24 hours a day.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Announced a future meeting regarding municipal aggregation and approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Locust Street Development Appeal
items.summary: Adopted a committee report to file a notice of appeal in the Locust Street development lawsuit and requested $5,000 for legal expenses.
